== A. PROOF OF ABSENCE (extracted_kernel_absence_proof.csv) ==
- Tables present in BOTH /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/output/fr13_b1_profile_bind/native/logs/native_nsys.sqlite and .../chain_replay_on/logs/chain_nsys.sqlite (49 tables each): CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS (14,368 / 43,270 rows), CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME (211,497 / 313,345), CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY (3,689 / 12,054), CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET (574 / 1,378), CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SYNCHRONIZATION (18,398 / 30,038), CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CUDA_EVENT, OVERHEAD, NVTX (only cub ranges), DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT, StringIds (140 rows).
- ABSENT in both: CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL and CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL (no kernel-like table at all; only ENUM_CUDA_KERNEL_LAUNCH_TYPE enum). Zero kernel-name strings in StringIds (only runtime-API names + log text). All 43,270/14,368 CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS rows have the single name 'Graph Node Creation' (capture-time events; zero node-execution rows).
- nsys 2026.2.1 (/opt/nvidia/nsight-systems-cli/2026.2.1/bin/nsys, runs on HOST too) `stats --report cuda_gpu_kern_sum` on both reps: "SKIPPED: ... does not contain CUDA kernel data". `cuda_gpu_trace` emits ONLY memcpy rows.
- ROOT CAUSE IS NOT GRAPH GRANULARITY: META_DATA_CAPTURE in both arms records CUDA_GRAPH_TRACE_OPTIONS:MODE = Node and TRACE_DEVICE_GRAPH_LAUNCH = true — the launcher already passes --cuda-graph-trace=node (scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh L251, fr10 launcher L253).
- ACTUAL ROOT CAUSE: DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT in both arms: "Number of incomplete CUPTI events dropped: 55,452 (native) / 78,134 (chain). Incomplete events appear when GPU timestamp information have not been retrieved at the time the profiling session was stopped." (≈ the eager-launch + graph-node-exec volume), plus "CUDA profiling might have not been started correctly" / "Not all CUDA events might have been collected". Sessions ended by --delay 360 --duration 240 expiry (STOP_TRIGGER=Delayed) while vllm serve kept running; CUDA_FLUSH_PERIOD=0 (flush only on buffer-full); CUDA_FLUSH_ON_CUDA_PROFILER_STOP=false. Both arms were IDLE for the last ~75 s (native) / ~110 s (chain) of the window and kernel records STILL dropped — so the at-stop flush is broken for kernel records on GB10 sbsa CUPTI (libcupti-sbsa.so.13.2); host-side runtime rows and a subset of memcpy/memset/sync GPU rows survived. Fix = periodic --cuda-flush-interval (confirmed by 2026.2.1's own --help: "--cuda-flush-interval=<ms> ... buffered CUDA data is automatically saved"; node granularity help: "If 'node' is selected, node activities will be collected ... may cause significant runtime overhead"; default is 'graph' for driver >= 11.7). Online confirmation: NVIDIA Nsight Systems User Guide troubleshooting recommends --cuda-flush-interval for data lost before exit, plus cudaProfilerStop/--flush-on-cudaprofilerstop (not wirable into vllm serve) — https://docs.nvidia.com/nsight-systems/UserGuide/index.html , https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/nsight-systems-does-not-collect-cuda-events/195856 , node-granularity usage example https://docs.modular.com/max/gpu-system-profiling/ .

== B. WHAT WAS ATTRIBUTABLE (all CSVs in /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/output/fr13_b1_profile_bind/) ==
Decode windows = union of cudaGraphLaunch bursts (gap>2s, >=50 launches): native 18.11 s / 72 drafts; chain 24.07 s / 69 drafts (true draft counts from native_probe.json / chain_probe.json metric_delta.spec_drafts; s/fwd 0.2170 vs 0.3044 = 1.4025x).
CSVs: extracted_runtime_api_decode_sum.csv, extracted_runtime_api_decode_engine_thread.csv, extracted_runtime_api_full_sum.csv, extracted_gpu_memcpy_memset_decode.csv, extracted_memcpyasync_blocking_hist_decode.csv, extracted_dtoh_size_hist_decode.csv, extracted_sync_decode_sum.csv, extracted_graph_capture_clusters.csv, extracted_decode_delta_per_draft.csv (headline), extracted_chain_blocking_readback.csv, extracted_kernel_absence_proof.csv.

Headline per-draft deltas (engine thread, decode window; chain minus native):
1) WAIT RELOCATION + GROWTH: native waits 220.9 ms/draft (cudaEventSynchronize 129.6 + cudaStreamSynchronize 89.9; 378 eventSyncs on engine + a dedicated waiter thread parked 16.3 s in eventSync — async output path). Chain waits 318.5 ms/draft, but 315.7 ms/draft of it sits inside blocking cudaMemcpyAsync (>=1ms blockers, only 2.64 calls/draft). Delta = +97.6 ms/draft of GPU-side-or-serialization time ≈ the whole 1.40x gap (86 ms/fwd by /metrics).
2) THE BLOCKING READBACK PAIR (extracted_chain_blocking_readback.csv): exactly one 40-byte DtoH (73 calls, avg block 164.5 ms) + one 20-byte DtoH (71 calls, avg block 136.3 ms) per draft event on the engine thread — the tree committer synchronously reads back 5x int64 token ids + 5x int32 (K=5 chain) and absorbs the entire forward wait there. Native has only 39 blockers >=1ms totaling 97 ms in the whole window. NOTE: this is the WAIT LOCATION, not proven cause (engine is API-busy 95% vs native 92%; the GPU pipeline behind the readback is what is slow — needs kernel rows). It is NOT the ruled-out per-layer .item() class: it is 2/draft, committer-level.
3) EAGER KERNELS OUTSIDE GRAPHS: 194.1/draft native vs 383.8/draft chain (+190, ~2x; cudaLaunchKernel+cuLaunchKernel+cuLaunchKernelEx), API time 5.5 -> 6.7 ms/draft. At B=1 on GB10 each eager launch is also a GPU bubble candidate — unattributable to kernel names without re-profile.
4) GRAPH LAUNCHES: same count/draft (11.93 vs 11.81) but 2.46x API cost each (24.4 us -> 60.0 us); total 0.29 -> 0.71 ms/draft.
5) GRAPH NODE INFLATION LOCALIZED (extracted_graph_capture_clusters.csv): capture clusters — native main-model phases 4,029 + 4,025 creation events vs chain 18,487 + 18,378 (4.57x); the 3,148-event clusters (MTP drafter graphs) are IDENTICAL in both arms. So the 3.14x runtime graph-nodes/draft (627.1 vs 199.6) lives entirely in the MAIN-MODEL verify graph, not the drafter.
6) GPU-SIDE COPIES (extracted_gpu_memcpy_memset_decode.csv): DtoH 4.2/draft native vs 110.2/draft chain (7,036 of chain's 7,607 are 4-byte); GPU-side copy time trivial (0.42 ms vs 6.9 ms total) — the DtoH tax is CPU-block/serialization, not bandwidth. HtoD 39.3 vs 53.2/draft; memset 7.6 -> 19.3/draft.
7) Decode-window sanity: engine-thread API busy = 16.69/18.11 s (native) vs 22.89/24.07 s (chain); windows overshoot /metrics decode (15.63/21.00 s) by inter-event scheduler gaps.

WHAT REMAINS UNANSWERABLE WITHOUT RE-PROFILE: the requested split of the +97.6 ms/draft GPU-side time into _tree_gdn_kernel / _tree_gdn_replay_kernel / remap / activation-ring copies / native GDN/conv / attention / sampler-committer kernels — zero kernel rows exist, in graphs AND eager.
